zh.heading: # 对审稿意见的逐条答复（草案）
zh.scope_line: 说明：本答复信配合组织方基线 `{b}` 的受控修订演练撰写，逐条对应组织方整理的意见摘要；信中引用的文字来自该摘要，并非审稿报告的逐字原文，也未加入所给材料以外的实验、数据或文献。
zh.agree_all: 感谢审稿人指出该问题，我们采纳并完成了相应修订。
zh.agree_partial: 我们对该意见予以部分采纳，在现有材料能支撑的范围内完成了修订。
zh.hold_original: 我们理解审稿人的关注点；经复核基线原文，我们保留原有表述并说明理由。
zh.clarify_reading: 感谢审稿人提出的意见，我们就此处表述作如下澄清。
zh.factual_mismatch: 我们需指出：该意见与基线文本的描述并不一致。
zh.changed_block: 修改后的文字（`{d}` 第 `{loc}` 块）：
zh.no_change_block: 该项未在本次基线修订中落实，原因见 `evidence_pending.md`。

en.heading: # Point-by-Point Reply to the Comments (draft)
en.scope_line: Note: this reply belongs to a controlled revision drill on the organizer baseline `{b}` and answers the organizer's comment summary item by item. Quoted wording comes from that summary, not from a verbatim referee report, and no experiment, dataset or reference beyond the supplied materials has been added.
en.agree_all: We are grateful for this comment and have accepted it; the corresponding revision is in place.
en.agree_partial: We accept this comment in part and have made the revisions that the supplied materials support.
en.hold_original: We understand the concern; having re-checked the baseline, we keep the original wording and explain why below.
en.clarify_reading: We thank the reviewer for this comment and offer the following clarification of the wording.
en.factual_mismatch: We must note a factual discrepancy between this comment and the baseline text.
en.no_change_block: This item is not implemented in the current baseline revision; see `evidence_pending.md` for the reason.
